answer:
I added a full-width button at the top of the Habits app's Home screen. One tap on "I walked today" marks today (2026-10-06) as walked.

If today already has a row, the button sets its walk to true and leaves "read" alone. If there's no row, it adds one in date order. Once today is marked, the button changes to a disabled "Walked today" with a check mark. So it can't be tapped again, and a mistaken tap can't be undone from the app. The history list now shows the newest day first and labels today.

I didn't tap the button, so it hasn't run on your real data. The checks pass with no errors. The only remaining notes are about the tab-bar labels ("Home", "Settings"), which are small and low-contrast; I didn't change them.
